source_pins.reason: The current Draft makes CONTRIBUTES_TO general across Roles and Forms, makes explanatory-Requirement targets optional guidance, and distinguishes contribution from satisfaction.
A direct Relation Declaration owns its endpoint signature and classification; a direction needs its own outgoing permission.
The inherited zero default requires a matching named outgoing Atom permission; no inverse permission follows from a direct relation.
Atom currently grants only IS_CONTAINED_BY, HAS_ACTIVE_SUBJECT, and GOVERNS outgoing permissions.
Node's general outgoing-relation default remains zero and should not be widened generically.
Supplies the admitted direct-relation declaration pattern with an Atom Host and no authored inverse.
An inverse is a separate derived Relation with reversed endpoints, not an automatic companion of every direct Relation.

drafts.id_allocation: Root allocates a new ID only if this proposal is selected for native Draft authoring.
drafts.summary_status: new proposed identity; no Current Atom is renamed or superseded here
drafts.claim: CONTRIBUTES_TO is a direct, authored Relation from an Atom contributor to an Atom target toward which it contributes. It is available across Atom Roles and Forms. An Atom need not author a link, and the target is not restricted to a Requirement.
drafts.semantics: The Host contributes toward the Target. The Relation records contribution; it is not by itself evidence that a Requirement is satisfied.

endpoint_signature.host: Atom instance of any Role or Form
endpoint_signature.target: Atom instance of any Role or Form
endpoint_signature.reason: The adopted proposal makes the Relation universal. Its preferred explanatory-Requirement target is guidance only and explicitly does not narrow the general target population.

inverse.reason: No distinct reverse meaning is approved. Reverse written syntax remains available for the same fact under the endpoint rule, but no HAS_INVERSE binding or companion Relation is declared.

alias.reason: No symbolic notation has been approved or is needed for an unambiguous named Relation.

permission_update.scope: Add exactly one Atom-instance outgoing permission; do not change Node's wildcard default or any other Relation.
permission_update.reason: It permits zero or more optional authored outgoing contribution links. The Relation Declaration supplies the Atom-to-Atom endpoint domain; this adds neither a target-side permission nor a fixed/required target count.

admission_and_migration: The Atom-to-Atom endpoint signature does not itself alter Role or Form admission.
No existing Atom is required to acquire a CONTRIBUTES_TO link, and no link is inferred from containment, Scope Delegation, SPECIALIZES, GOVERNS, dependency, or shared topic.
Promotion requires coordinated successor Draft review for the Relation Declaration and the one CA-R-2508 permission addition; this analysis creates neither native Draft.
unresolved: None for the Relation endpoint population, inverse, alias, or optionality: the latest human decision and A1328 settle them.
Normal Draft placement, Tier, and ID allocation remain Root-owned authoring choices and are not selected here.

drafts.placement: Only create this separate guidance proposal if the preference must become normative. Its Method Form must use an already admitted guidance Form; this lane does not invent one.
drafts.guidance: An RMEDO Solution, Direct Policy, Approach Policy, or Decision may use CONTRIBUTES_TO to point to an existing Requirement that explains its purpose. The preferred Requirement target is explanatory, not a validity condition. Do not create a Requirement merely to fill the link, and do not treat the link as evidence that the Requirement is satisfied; satisfaction requires the applicable Evaluation and implementation evidence.
boundaries: A Relation link is not an admission rule for a Form.
A missing link, missing explanatory Requirement, or zero contribution links is not a model-invalidity finding.
